name: Developer
description: Writes, reviews and debugs code with agents.

axes.name: Task framing
axes.measures: Requests state the goal, constraints and done criteria up front

axes.name: Verification habit
axes.measures: Changes are checked with tests, linters or builds before moving on
signals: sessions with a check call after the last recorded edit

axes.name: Debugging method
axes.measures: Bugs are reproduced and narrowed down with logs and evidence before fixing

axes.name: Codebase context
axes.measures: The agent gets the files, docs and conventions it needs instead of guessing

axes.name: Tool reuse
axes.measures: Skills, MCP tools and subagents are used where they save work
